steps.speaker: Vex
steps.title: The Mixing Table
steps.body:
Unlike the equipment crafters, we work hands-on here. Drop ingredients into the slots and mix them — the result depends on the combination. Any recipe can be attempted at any time.

Upgrade my workshop for more mixing slots and better output quality. Check the Discovery Log to see what you've found so far — discovered recipes also appear in the General Store when you allocate shop slots to us. The Chef works the same way with food.

steps.speaker: Vex
steps.title: A Word of Caution
steps.body:
You'll want to think before you toss things in the crucible, friend. Old Merta — brilliant woman, steady hands — once mixed three things she swore would make a healing draught.

Took us two days to air out the shop and a week to find all of Merta.
